body.citation: Assaad, Charles K., Emilie Devijver, Eric Gaussier, Gregor Gössler, and Anouar Meynaoui (2024). Identifiability of total effects from abstractions of time series causal graphs. Proceedings of the Fortieth Conference on Uncertainty in Artificial Intelligence, PMLR 244, 173--185. Primary-source locator: Assumption 1, p. 175; Definition 4 and equation (1), p. 176; Theorem 2, pp. 184--185; and https://proceedings.mlr.press/v244/assaad24a.html. The PMLR abstract describes necessary-and-sufficient SCG conditions, while the proceedings theorem and conclusion label the displayed conditions sufficient.
